currentIndependentAssessment.coreConclusion: The MVP has materially improved engineering containment and produced substantial policy drafts, but the legal risk of inaccurate published product/company representations, third-party IP/data rights and cross-border operation remains unresolved. Legal protections are strongest when lawful corporate structure, evidence-backed claims, working corrections, proper rights and active operations reinforce each other. Disclaimers or labelling the company 'educational' do not neutralise these exposures. Public release NO-GO.

strategicRiskOpinion.opinion: Most consequential preventable exposure is an identifiable false assertion, parent-company link or unsupported implication in Claims, Highlights, Signals, score-band narratives or a share card. Formal 'opinion' wording is not a complete defence where users infer factual claims.
strategicRiskOpinion.recommendedControls: For each displayed assertion retain a dated provenance/substantiation chain, exact barcode/variant/market, source dates, methodology and confidence limits; prove product identity and company mapping; make the overall impression fair; suppress unverified high-severity allegation rather than fabricate score changes; counsel review negative/company-specific templates.

strategicRiskOpinion.opinion: The hold code reduces risk only if staffed, secure, observable and effective across caches, deep links, social previews and multiple devices. A dormant mailto address is not an operating dispute process.
strategicRiskOpinion.recommendedControls: Staff monitored intake with backup, severity tiers and response targets, evidence preservation, reversible case-based administrative holds, founder/counsel escalation, audit, public correction policy and rehearsed release process. Test stale cache/social share and deliberate service faults before launch.

strategicRiskOpinion.opinion: Technical attribution alone cannot conclusively clear ODbL derivative-database obligations, CC BY-SA images, trademark/packaging rights or BBFAW/KTC benchmark reuse. OFF commercial access is conditional, not categorically barred.
strategicRiskOpinion.recommendedControls: Trace every sourced item from ingest to Result/Share Card/OG/social export; build permission and attribution register by source/version/use; request BBFAW/KTC written clarification; if rights absent, redesign only the specific high-risk output via an explicitly approved publication-governance change.

strategicRiskOpinion.opinion: Incorporation in a favourable country may limit some shareholder exposure, but generally does not eliminate personal misconduct exposure or legal claims in NZ/AU or other places where services are targeted. A company 'type' label (technology/publisher/education) is not immunity.
strategicRiskOpinion.recommendedControls: Decide incorporation and real operating substance with NZ/AU corporate, media, privacy and tax counsel; establish proper limited-liability structure where suitable, founder IP assignments, clear contracting entity and affiliate arrangements, director controls, separate accounts, adequate reserves, appropriate media/technology E&O, cyber and D&O insurance if available and effective.

strategicRiskOpinion.opinion: If consumers interpret the 0-100 result as verified health/safety/environmental certification, caveats deep in Terms may not correct misleading overall presentation. Source quality and confidence are not proofs of accuracy.
strategicRiskOpinion.recommendedControls: Use precise implemented-method language at the point of decision, clear NR/Checking/administrative-hold differences, source freshness, avoidance of categorical safety claims, and careful packaging/allergen/recall separation. Validate negative share copy as a distinct high-exposure publication surface.

strategicRiskOpinion.opinion: The privacy regime depends on facts, flows and applicable entity/territory law; assumptions of anonymity or Australian small-business exemption are unsafe. Independent server logs and contributions can reveal personal information.
strategicRiskOpinion.recommendedControls: Minimise data, maintain current data-flow map and subprocessors, appoint accountable privacy officer, written retention/deletion and breach response; assess NZ IPP3A indirect collection, AU APP/small-business exception conditions; verify contributors explicitly authorise public OFF uploads separately from private EA evidence.

strategicRiskOpinion.opinion: Code-only launch gates provide substantial friction but cannot prevent unrestricted users submitting an older binary or manually promoting Vercel. 'Highest legal protection' requires enforced organisational controls and regular review.
strategicRiskOpinion.recommendedControls: Protect credentials/branches/environments and store roles; signed counsel and founder release checklist tied to exact SHA/build; prohibit marketing beyond approved territories; require independently observed end-to-end device, backend and outage tests; postlaunch monitoring, vulnerability response and prompt correction procedures.
